reviews.text: I dropped off my dog like I have a bunch of times before and I got a phone call minutes later after leaving him that they could not complete the bath because he was crying and being anxious, we returned once again from home to find him wet and behaving quietly, im not sure how these groomers are trained but they apparently dont have any pet handling experience or patience. We have been coming here for years and they have clearly lost good groomers because we never had issues and suddenly it was an issue today. You should not be working with dogs if you cant handle them or if you are scared of big dogs. Its not cheap and for the prices being charged we would hope that there be decently experienced groomers

Jaxon loves coming here for bath time! Really appreciate the shampoo options for self service wash at no additional charge. Its $18 for 15 minutes of wash time. I never feel rushed and the tubs are always clean. They do also have professional groomers Onsite as well as an attached dog mart for all your needs. Awesome place and always a great experience!

I visit the Urban Pet regularly for the last few years with my dog. We recently used Moon Shine for grooming for the first time after our groomer closed shop. Tonight I took my dog to Urban Pet to get treats and he CRIED at the entrance to the groomer because I would not open the door so he could go in there. He is 7 years old and this is the third time in his life that he has been upset enough to cry about something. They did a good job with his bath and haircut. He is a Pekingese and he was partially matted after a day in water and had an injury on his tail as well. I figured his grooming appointment was unpleasant for him that day but of course still necessary and I was happy with the job they did but I am REALLY amazed by how eager he is to return to visit them. Very sweet.

Only Ana can cut my chaotic dachshunds nails. I love coming to self wash too always easy to use, with different shampoo options, towels and blow dryer.  But do get the quarterly groom so The grooming packet stamp card is well worth the money.

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I’ve been bringing my Poodle-Shih Tzu, Luke Skywalker, to Moonshine Grooming every 8 weeks for years, and they are hands down the best. Luke Skywalker is a very difficult customer who typically doesn't like being poked or prodded, but Dede is a miracle worker.
She has a unique connection with him that even I don’t have; she manages to get him to cooperate perfectly and completes his full treatment every single time. It is such a relief to have a groomer like Dede who my dog actually trusts. I am attaching a before and after photo so you can see the transformation she achieves. If you want the best care for your pet—especially if they are a little stubborn—this is the place to go.
Love this place. Patrick is the absolute best and most considerate groomer. He always knows exactly how to make our dog feel at ease in an otherwise stressful environment for her.

My German Shepherd Zara is not a big fan of baths or dog washes but she was a trooper today- we used the self wash station and it was extremely convenient having everything provided by the staff (shampoo, conditioner, brushes, towels, apron etc). Amazing setup having the wash hose and dryer all in one tub. The staff was super helpful and friendly and we had a great experience! In shop music was also great while going through the wash process!

Great price for everything they provide!

I’ve done a few different dog washing sites and this one was by far the smoothest and best setup! Thank you!!

We move Ana - she is who we trust with our precious senior dog's grooming. My dog is my best friend and she is super sensitive about her paws. Ana works with dogs to gain their trust- she does not force it, instead she demonstrates her patience and care and it has paid off. I used to have to hold my dog and be there for the nail trimming, but now my fur baby looks forward
to getting dropped off at the salon for her full service bath and nail care with her fave caregiver and stylist: Ana ♥️

I wanna give a big shout out to the groomers here especially Ana. She does an amazing job with our family dog Chewy. I have been taking him here for the past year and have nothing but great things to say. She is timely, efficient and always treats my pup well. Thank you again!

Shoutout to Moonshine Grooming/The
Urban Pet.
Recommended by a neighbor who happens to be a dog trainer. I was just a kid when I last had a pet. (Family Dog) so I had to learn how to properly care for a pet including grooming. Long Story short!
The Staff is Super Friendly and attentive.
Easy to schedule appointments.
Reasonable prices.
I thought it would be good to consistently have the same groomer work on our dog
"Lucky"
That's where Anna (Groomer) comes into the picture. She's Great! Really Nice, Top tier grooming skills!!! ..... more
importantly my wife loves the way Lucky comes home after a session. Ask for Anna and schedule an appointment with her. You won't be disappointed!! I felt at ease leaving our dog there and felt like he's around good people-and in good hands.

Very convenient to have this grooming place right inside the Urban Pet. DeeDee worked magin on my new rescue who is still terrified of clipping nails, DeeDee was so kind, patient and understanding, we will definitely come back.
Side note, there are few self wash stations for those who are interested, advisable to book ahead of time.
I brought my Doodle here for the 2nd time. I love it. Great price.

I’ve taken my one-year-old Pomeranian to Moonshine Groomer a few times and always liked their service. But today was a huge disappointment.

I brought him to his usual groomer, Anna, and we talked about cutting his coat shorter — he’s a fluffball who normally gets a scissor cut with some shaping. Instead, I was shocked to pick him up after two and a half hours completely shaved down. I never asked for this, and no one called to check with me before making such a drastic decision. To make it worse, I was charged extra for the longer stay.

For context, his last grooming was just two months ago and his coat was in perfectly normal condition. Shaving a Pomeranian can permanently damage the coat, and now it will take months to grow back — if it ever does. I called afterward and was told the manager would follow up, but no one ever called me back.

I’ve had good experiences here in the past, which makes this all the more disappointing. I’m sharing this so other Pomeranian owners know to be careful, and so the salon takes this feedback seriously.

Moon Shine Grooming & Pet Wash in Los Angeles offers an exceptional experience for both pets and their owners. The self-wash stations are thoughtfully maintained, spacious, and equipped with premium supplies that make the entire process more convenient and stress-free. Ana’s knowledge and calm demeanor truly set the tone—she administered my dog’s Bordetella vaccine with care and precision, creating a calm environment even for my usually anxious pup. The facility is spotless, and you can tell the staff genuinely values animal well-being. Highly recommended for responsible pet care in a clean, welcoming space.

Loveee how well they treated our dog + how well they groomed her. You can tell the people who work here enjoy their work. From the get-go everyone was so friendly.

Zada did a wonderful job with Luna’s cut. We love her work! I’m happy we’ve found the perfect place to take Luna moving forward 🫶

Ana and the moon shine staff are great! The day after my Goldens first bath he pulled me back to moon shine to say hi, he loved them so much. He always prances out looking and smelling his best. He gets a deep conditioning bath and it takes less than an hour and a half. I’d highly recommend their services!

Ana is the best! She’s been grooming my German shepherd / husky mix Rey for almost a year now, and I couldn’t be happier with her work. Rey always comes back looking fresh, smelling great, and super happy. Plus I love the bandanas they put on him at the end. You can tell she genuinely cares about the dogs she works with, and that makes all the difference. If you’re looking for a great groomer, I highly recommend her. Also they are fast so if you don’t like waiting 3-4 hours for your dog to be washed / groomed this is the place to go.

The only two ppl who my dog allows to trim his nails are Deedee & Patrick! His a short hair doxie and sensitive and I’ve definitely spoiled him so he needs a bit more patience:) we’ve been loyal customers for more than 6 years bc of these 2 amazing groomers.
I've used Moonshine 3 times and was happy every time.
Friendliest staff and honestly a great price for a self service dog wash!
Always love coming here! Dede is the best and keeps our pups looking great! We especially love their chic bandanas :)

We really love this place. The only bad thing I would say is that it's not closer to where I live. Haha.
But we buy the pronto raw food from urban pet. We self shower our husky here. Also would be nice if the grooming side would open early like urban pet.
Clean, easy parking
We love this place only wash our dog will go to everyone is always friendly and waiting to help if you go you will not be unsatisfied
If you guys are going to demand people call your dinosaur phone line to make an appointment instead of using a simple website contact form, you should probably make it a point to answer your phone.
